thai: จัดสรร
meaning: to give something to someone for a particular purpose
exampleSentence: The company allocated more funds to the marketing department.

thai: ได้รับ, ได้มา, เข้าซื้อ
meaning: to obtain or gain something
exampleSentence: The company plans to acquire a smaller competitor next year.

thai: อนุมัติ, เห็นชอบ
meaning: to officially accept or agree to something
exampleSentence: The manager approved the employee's request for leave.

thai: เข้าร่วม, เข้าร่วมงาน
meaning: to be present at an event, meeting, or place
exampleSentence: All employees are required to attend the annual meeting.

thai: ว่าง, พร้อมใช้งาน, มีอยู่
meaning: ready to be used, obtained, or contacted
exampleSentence: The conference room is available after three o'clock.

thai: ประโยชน์, ผลประโยชน์
meaning: an advantage or positive effect
exampleSentence: Employees receive several benefits in addition to their salary.

thai: ยืนยัน
meaning: to state or show that something is definitely true or correct
exampleSentence: Please confirm your reservation by Friday.

thai: พิจารณา
meaning: to think carefully about something before making a decision
exampleSentence: The committee will consider the proposal at its next meeting.

thai: ล่าช้า, เลื่อน
meaning: to make something happen later than planned
exampleSentence: Bad weather delayed the delivery by two days.

thai: จัดส่ง, ส่งมอบ
meaning: to take goods, documents, or messages to a person or place
exampleSentence: The supplier will deliver the equipment tomorrow morning.

thai: มีประสิทธิภาพ
meaning: working well without wasting time, energy, or resources
exampleSentence: The new system is more efficient than the previous one.

thai: ประมาณการ, ประเมิน
meaning: to roughly calculate the cost, size, value, or amount of something
exampleSentence: We estimate that the repairs will cost about five thousand dollars.

thai: ขยาย, ขยายตัว
meaning: to increase in size, number, or importance
exampleSentence: The company intends to expand its operations in Asia.

thai: ดำเนินการ, นำไปใช้
meaning: to put a plan, decision, or system into effect
exampleSentence: The company will implement the new policy next month.

thai: เพิ่ม, เพิ่มขึ้น
meaning: to become or make something greater in amount, number, or size
exampleSentence: The company hopes to increase sales by ten percent this year.

thai: รักษา, บำรุงรักษา
meaning: to keep something in good condition or at the same level
exampleSentence: Regular inspections help maintain the equipment in good condition.

thai: เจรจา, ต่อรอง
meaning: to discuss something formally in order to reach an agreement
exampleSentence: The company is negotiating a new contract with the supplier.

thai: แจ้ง, แจ้งให้ทราบ
meaning: to formally tell someone about something
exampleSentence: Customers will be notified of any changes to the schedule.

thai: ได้รับ, ได้มา
meaning: to get something through effort or request
exampleSentence: Applicants must obtain permission before entering the facility.

thai: เข้าร่วม, มีส่วนร่วม
meaning: to take part in an activity or event
exampleSentence: More than fifty employees participated in the training session.

thai: เลื่อนออกไป
meaning: to arrange for something to happen at a later time
exampleSentence: The meeting was postponed until next Monday.

thai: ซื้อ, การซื้อ
meaning: to buy something
exampleSentence: Customers can purchase tickets through the company's website.

thai: แนะนำ
meaning: to suggest that someone should do or choose something
exampleSentence: The consultant recommended upgrading the computer system.

thai: ต้องการ, กำหนดให้ต้องมี
meaning: to need something or make something necessary
exampleSentence: This position requires at least two years of experience.

thai: กำหนดเวลา, ตารางเวลา
meaning: to arrange for something to happen at a particular time
exampleSentence: The interview has been scheduled for Thursday morning.

thai: ส่ง, ยื่น
meaning: to formally give a document or request to someone for consideration
exampleSentence: Please submit your expense report by the end of the week.

thai: เพียงพอ
meaning: enough for a particular purpose
exampleSentence: There is sufficient space in the warehouse for the new equipment.

thai: ชั่วคราว
meaning: lasting for only a limited period of time
exampleSentence: The company hired temporary workers during the busy season.

thai: ว่าง, ไม่มีผู้ครอบครอง
meaning: not currently occupied or filled
exampleSentence: There are currently three vacant positions in the sales department.

thai: ตรวจสอบ, ยืนยันความถูกต้อง
meaning: to check that something is true, accurate, or correct
exampleSentence: Please verify the customer's information before processing the order.
